Subject: [PATCH] staging: wfx: remove remaining code of 'secure link' feature
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit e8d607ce0c81 ("staging: wfx: drop 'secure link' feature") had
removed the 'secure link' feature. However, a few lines of codes were
yet here.

Fixes: e8d607ce0c81 ("staging: wfx: drop 'secure link' feature")
Signed-off-by: Jérôme Pouiller <jerome.pouiller@silabs.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201007101943.749898-3-Jerome.Pouiller@silabs.com

diff --git a/drivers/staging/wfx/debug.c b/drivers/staging/wfx/debug.c
index ae44ffb66e34..4bd5f9fa21a1 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/wfx/debug.c
+++ b/drivers/staging/wfx/debug.c
@@ -230,21 +230,6 @@ static const struct file_operations wfx_send_pds_fops = {
 	.write = wfx_send_pds_write,
 };
 
-static ssize_t wfx_burn_slk_key_write(struct file *file,
-				      const char __user *user_buf,
-				      size_t count, loff_t *ppos)
-{
-	struct wfx_dev *wdev = file->private_data;
-
-	dev_info(wdev->dev, "this driver does not support secure link\n");
-	return -EINVAL;
-}
-
-static const struct file_operations wfx_burn_slk_key_fops = {
-	.open = simple_open,
-	.write = wfx_burn_slk_key_write,
-};
-
 struct dbgfs_hif_msg {
 	struct wfx_dev *wdev;
 	struct completion complete;
@@ -366,8 +351,6 @@ int wfx_debug_init(struct wfx_dev *wdev)
 	debugfs_create_file("tx_power_loop", 0444, d, wdev,
 			    &wfx_tx_power_loop_fops);
 	debugfs_create_file("send_pds", 0200, d, wdev, &wfx_send_pds_fops);
-	debugfs_create_file("burn_slk_key", 0200, d, wdev,
-			    &wfx_burn_slk_key_fops);
 	debugfs_create_file("send_hif_msg", 0600, d, wdev,
 			    &wfx_send_hif_msg_fops);
 	debugfs_create_file("ps_timeout", 0600, d, wdev, &wfx_ps_timeout_fops);
--

index 17db67559f5e..db8d06fc4baa 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/wfx/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/wireless/siliabs,wfx.txt
+++ b/drivers/staging/wfx/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/wireless/siliabs,wfx.txt
@@ -90,8 +90,6 @@ Some properties are recognized either by SPI and SDIO versions:
    this property, driver will disable most of power saving features.
  - config-file: Use an alternative file as PDS. Default is `wf200.pds`. Only
    necessary for development/debug purpose.
- - slk_key: String representing hexadecimal value of secure link key to use.
-   Must contains 64 hexadecimal digits. Not supported in current version.
 
 WFx driver also supports `mac-address` and `local-mac-address` as described in
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/ethernet.txt

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/staging/wfx/debug.c`**
   - Removed the function `wfx_burn_slk_key_write`, which was responsible for handling writes to a secure link key.
   - Removed the associated file operations structure `wfx_burn_slk_key_fops` that was linked to the secure link key functionality.
   - Deleted the line that created a debugfs entry for the secure link key (`burn_slk_key`), effectively removing any interface for this feature.

2. **File: `drivers/staging/wfx/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/wireless/siliabs,wfx.txt`**
   - Removed the documentation entry for the `slk_key` property, which described the secure link key as a hexadecimal string. The note indicated that this feature is not supported in the current version.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `debug.c` and the documentation file are directly related as they both pertain to the removal of the 'secure link' feature from the driver. The code changes eliminate the implementation and interface for the secure link key, while the documentation update reflects this removal by deleting references to the `slk_key` property. Together, these changes ensure that both the codebase and its documentation are consistent in indicating that the secure link feature is no longer supported.
